astranl.do_not_use_when: you need approval, checkout, payment, dispatch, receipt confirmation, or a store order
astranl.next_possible_action: a project administrator reviews and approves the exact list
required_inputs: project agent key on the connection
astranl.use_when: you hold an estimate token and a project agent key and need to import, inspect or finish a purchase-list draft

annotations.title: Prepare project materials for administrator approval

description: Turn an AstraNL estimate into draft purchase lists for a project, one list per store and wave, and hand them to the project administrator. Needs the project agent key (agk_...) as X-Agent-Key on the connection; the estimate tools use the connection key, so use a separate connection. Read-only actions: me, case, estimate_links, list, order_status (reads an existing order record, it never places one). Actions that write: import_estimate (creates draft lists) and finish_list (sends one draft for approval). Required fields by action: me: none; case: project_id; import_estimate: project_id, estimate_case_id, estimate_token, idempotency_key; estimate_links: project_id; list: project_id, list_id; finish_list: project_id, list_id, list_revision, version, idempotency_key; order_status: project_id, order_id. Typical order: import_estimate, then list for each list_id, then finish_list with the revision and version read. The estimate must be RELEASED after review and must carry a material order plan, otherwise import_estimate answers a failure and writes nothing. If a write answers outcome_unknown, repeat the same call with the SAME idempotency_key; never use a new key. A project administrator approves the exact list. Nothing is ordered, approved or paid by this tool. A 202 means accepted for work, not completed.

action.description: what to do; see the tool description for the fields each action takes

estimate_token.description: the token of that estimate case, from estimate_case_create

idempotency_key.description: 8 to 80 letters, digits, - or _; the same key replays the same answer

list_revision.description: the revision of the list as read

version.description: the current_version of the list as read

name: order_materials
